events.description: Accident on road_0153 (loc_0094–loc_0093) blocks a short, high‑traffic link close to the main axis, forcing vehicles to detour around the busy junction at loc_0094.

Slowdown on roads 0152 and 0454 (linking loc_0094 and loc_0267) slows traffic on an alternative route, discouraging use of the already congested axis.
